reviews.text: Julia is very kind and caring. I've been taking my baby to her for over two years because I know he feels very safe and secure, and so do I ♥️ I highly recommend her; in addition to her wonderful manner, she's a true professional 🫶🏼☺️

The service has always been excellent from the start. Julia is very kind and attentive. The place is always organized, clean, and smells wonderful. She gives my dog ​​a beautiful, perfect haircut. Highly recommended! 👏👏 …
She does a great job with my dog, which is probably difficult since he hates being groomed; however, he comes back clean and trimmed for a good price.
The service is excellent, 10/10, and the place is always clean. Highly recommended.
Very professional, my dogs Rocky and Tina are delighted 😀 …
Excellent service and patience with Sol, highly recommended, thank you very much!
Julia is a true professional!! So loving with furry friends!! She's a sweetheart and leaves my two Spanish Water Dogs looking amazing 💘 …
Excellent, high-quality hair salon. Great service.

Wonderful service for my little dog, recently adopted and very timid; it didn't seem likely she'd get her hair and nails trimmed. When I picked her up, it was a miracle she'd been able to do it. Perfect nails, a great haircut, and she was surprisingly calm. She'll definitely be back. Without a doubt, a true professional!
Professionalism, seriousness and affection with my furry Diana, an adopted Griffon, she always looks gorgeous when I take her to Julia's...

This is the groomer where I always take Leo, my Spanish Water Dog, and Julia is super professional. She always makes him look gorgeous, and his coat is healthy and moisturized. I'm so lucky to have her in the neighborhood!

We've been taking Leo to Branco Hair Salon for over a year now, and I have to say we couldn't be happier! Leo is a Pomeranian, and not everyone specializes in this type of coat! Leo always looks gorgeous and is always happy to go! Just look at his smile! 100% 10 out of 10!

I’m really happy with the service and the results. All my preferences were counted and I like my dogs haircut very much.

And the price is very good. I recommend this place!

A great place to take my dogs!
The person who works there is very nice, 10/10! I left my Tato exactly as I asked, very happy with the result.

Ever since Julia opened her grooming salon for our furry friends, we've been taking them there all the time. Julia is lovely with them and an excellent professional; she makes my dog, Pirri, look absolutely gorgeous!

My favorite hair salon because I go with my pet, Coco.
I'm delighted with the service. I recommend it 100%.
Julia is a true professional. She has a special connection with dogs; they all adore her. Her work is top-notch; no matter the breed, she makes them look absolutely gorgeous.
